run-inner.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,os,subprocess,time
root=Path.cwd(); task=root/'.local/tool-tasks/opening-member-pruning-20261008'
host=root/'.local/tool-tasks/intrinsic-card-value-20261006/updated-harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
artifacts={'A':root/'.local/tool-tasks/soul-current-pruning-20261008/build-prototype/CombatSolver.dll','C':task/'build-pilot/CombatSolver.dll'}
requests=Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests')
records=[]
for scene in ['dev-06-silent-boss','dev-04-necrobinder-elite']:
 for label in ['A1','C1']:
  out=task/'pure-inner'/scene/label;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
  dll=artifacts[label[0]]; request=requests/(scene+'.json')
  cmd=['dotnet',str(host),'--request',str(request),'--label','reviewed-growth-pilot-inner-'+scene+'-'+label,'--out',str(out),'--profile','VeryHigh','--dop','16','--budget-ms','300000','--search-mode','Coordinator','--nodes','500000','--beam','135','--card-branches','72','--pile-branches','42','--hand-branches','54','--enable-no-gc-region','--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes','16','--use-portfolio','--production-budget']
  env=os.environ.copy();env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL']=str(dll)
  for key in list(env):
   if (key.startswith('OFFLINE_HARNESS_') and key!='OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL') or key.startswith('COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY') or key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled','COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled','COMBATSOLVER_MEASUREMENT_TRACE']:env.pop(key,None)
  plan={'scene':scene,'label':label,'command':cmd,'outerTimeoutSeconds':120,'dllSha256':hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'requestSha256':hashlib.sha256(request.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'noProfilerOrCorrectnessInstrumentation':True}
  (out/'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
  start=time.monotonic()
  with (out/'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
   proc=subprocess.Popen(cmd,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
   try:code=proc.wait(timeout=120);status='Completed' if code==0 else 'Failed'
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait();code=proc.returncode;status='TimeoutNoRetry'
  record={'scene':scene,'label':label,'status':status,'exitCode':code,'launcherWallSeconds':time.monotonic()-start,'path':str(out/'result.json'),'plan':plan}
  if status=='Completed':
   result=json.loads((out/'result.json').read_text())
   record.update({k:result[k] for k in ['wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','comparisonQuality','budget','solverMetrics','pruneCounters','timeBoundaryObserved']})
   record['rootStampSha256']=hashlib.sha256(result['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()
   record['policy']=json.loads((out/'search-policy.json').read_text())
   record['resultSha256']=hashlib.sha256((out/'result.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  records.append(record);(task/'pure-inner-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({k:record.get(k) for k in ['scene','label','status','wallSeconds','peakProcessWorkingSetBytes','comparisonQuality']},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
  if status!='Completed':raise SystemExit('Terminal result retained; no retry of unchanged failed input.')
